proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitMechanics.lineage_choice
proposed_widenings.justification: The trait is one build-time choice among mutually exclusive lineage payloads. The current species-trait surface only allows one passive payload or one activated payload, so it cannot represent a required branch selection without lying about which lineage was chosen.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Choose one of the following options; whichever one you choose..."

proposed_widenings.name: SpellAccessMode.prepared_with_use_count
proposed_widenings.justification: Forest Gnome grants a prepared spell that also has multiple free casts per long rest equal to Proficiency Bonus while remaining castable with spell slots. Existing spell-access modes cover once-per-long-rest or charge-based casts, but not a prepared grant with PB-scaled free uses.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "You also always have the Speak with Animals spell prepared. You can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest. You can also use any spell slots you have to cast the spell."

proposed_widenings.name: create_object_with_stored_spell_effect
proposed_widenings.justification: Rock Gnome creates a bounded-duration device that stores one chosen Prestidigitation effect, can be activated later by touch with a Bonus Action, is capped at three extant devices, and can be dismantled with a Utilize action. That is not expressible as the current passive or activated species-trait payloads.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "you can spend 10 minutes casting Prestidigitation to create a Tiny clockwork device ... the device produces that effect whenever you or another creature takes a Bonus Action to activate it with a touch. You can have three such devices in existence at a time, and each falls apart 8 hours after its creation or when you dismantle it with a touch as a Utilize action."

notes: No content file was authored. The current surface cannot honestly encode a species trait whose top-level mechanic is a mandatory lineage branch with materially different downstream mechanics.
